job.title: Software Engineer, Profile & Community, Android
job.pay_full: $162,000 – $186,000 a year base pay; may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits

details.about: Airbnb's Profile & Community team, part of its Passport & Commerce organization, builds the social layer of Airbnb: a trusted graph of real-world connections and the social features on top of it that help people connect with travelers they know and people they meet. The team works closely with design, product, data science, legal and marketing on features used by millions.
duties: Work with product managers, designers and engineers to design and deliver high-quality Android products
Deliver high-impact social initiatives end to end
Build efficient, reusable mobile components and reliable, performant, scalable architecture
Find areas for improvement and drive mobile best practices
Work with iOS and web engineers on shared cross-platform foundations
needs: 3+ years developing Android applications at scale with a high volume of users
Strong expertise building and maintaining high-performance, scalable consumer Android apps, preferably with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
Extensive experience with GraphQL and REST APIs
Strong product sense and a passion for Android UI and UX
Proven collaboration with product management, design and other iOS, Android and web engineers
details.benefits: Base pay range $162,000 – $186,000 a year; actual base pay depends on training, skills, experience and business needs, and the range may change. The role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits and Employee Travel Credits.
notes: Airbnb's job titles may span more than one career level
Airbnb posts its open roles on careers.airbnb.com; its recruiters only email from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com and never ask candidates for money or bank details
Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities
